  Loading DuckDB-Wasm and data…
</div>

## Categories Over Time {#categories}

<div id="categories-controls" style="display: none;">
  <div id="category-checkboxes"></div>
  <div id="ma-control" style="margin-top: 0.5em;"></div>
</div>
<div id="categories-chart"></div>

## Sankey Diagram {#sankey}

<div id="sankey-controls" style="display: none;"></div>
<div id="sankey-chart" style="margin-top: 1em;"></div>

## SQL Playground {#sql-playground}

<div id="sql-controls" style="display: none;"></div>
<div id="sql-results"></div>

<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.35.2.min.js"></script>
<script type="module">
import { getConnection } from "../assets/js/duckdb_init.js";
import { initCategoriesChart } from "../assets/js/explore_charts.js";
import { initSankey } from "../assets/js/sankey.js";
import { initSqlPlayground } from "../assets/js/sql_playground.js";

try {
  await getConnection();
  document.getElementById("loading-indicator").style.display = "none";

  document.getElementById("categories-controls").style.display = "";
  document.getElementById("sankey-controls").style.display = "";
  document.getElementById("sql-controls").style.display = "";

  await Promise.all([
    initCategoriesChart(),
    initSankey(),
    initSqlPlayground(),
  ]);
} catch (err) {
  document.getElementById("loading-indicator").textContent =
    "Failed to initialize: " + err.message;
  console.error(err);
}
</script>
